admission.justification: The canonical registry in models, application re-export, and six refusal emitters across cli/worktrees/application/mcp can drift from served skill anchors; guarded by test_refusal_references.py.

applicability: models/role_capsules/refusal_references.py, application/role_capsules/refusal_references.py, and all six core lifecycle refusal families (role_message, retire_child, task_doc review, worktree sync, knowledge_write/MQC, closeout/coherence).
conditions: REFUSAL_REFERENCES maps all 21 refusal keys to served skill://agents-remember/skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/<relpath>#<anchor> URIs that resolve to live files and anchors.
with_refusal_reference is fail-safe and idempotent, appends pointers without changing refusal codes, states, or structured error keys, and leaves ordinary role_message holdReason holds untouched.
exclusions: Ordinary non-refusal holds (holdReason) and non-lifecycle errors outside the six registered refusal families.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_refusal_references.py plus refusal suites (test_held_queue.py, test_role_message_files.py, test_review_state.py, test_task_doc_review_public.py, test_worktree_sync*.py, test_writer_rule_titles.py, test_tool_answer_rows_quality.py, test_worktree_closeout*.py, test_native_retire.py; clean-copy tree b3131ef29cf948ee4830a48540585bc841530c3a)

statement: A centralized fail-safe refusal_references registry maps 21 refusal keys to served skill://agents-remember/skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/<relpath>#<anchor> URIs wired across all six core lifecycle refusal families without changing refusal codes, states, or structured error keys, and CI verifies live anchor resolution and emitter key registration.
title: Centralized fail-safe Poka-Yoke refusal_references URI registry
